title: What Happens When a Black Widow Spider Bites You?
sources: World Health Organization, Venomous spider envenomation

lines.text: A black widow's venom is fifteen times more potent than a rattlesnake's.
lines.caps: Venom is *15 times | stronger than a | *rattlesnake

lines.text: The bite itself often feels like nothing more than a faint pinprick.
lines.caps: The bite feels | like a tiny | *pinprick

lines.text: Within thirty minutes, a destructive neurotoxin called alpha-latrotoxin floods your nerve endings.
It forces your motor synapses to dump all of their neurotransmitters simultaneously.
This triggers violent muscle spasms, making your abdominal wall as rigid as concrete.
lines.caps: Violent muscle *spasms | turn your stomach | *rock hard

lines.text: Severe cramping spreads to your back, accompanied by nausea and racing heart rates.
Fortunately, anti-venom is highly effective, and fatalities are extremely rare.
